caseNameFull: Adelbert L. Spitzer, as Spitzer-Rorick & Company v. Board of Trustees for the Regina Public School District No. 4 of Saskatchewan

opinions.text: December 20, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied. Mr. Thomas H. Tracy and Mr. George D. Welles for petitioners. No appearance for respondent.
